overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the unexecuted nonunion executive session topic could not support a notice claim, and no evidence showed off-meeting deliberation on board appointments.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the August 30 executive session notice topic on nonunion personnel negotiations was not detailed enough, since it did not name the personnel.
allegations.key_passage: However, where a public body does not actually engage in any deliberation on a particular topic, it cannot violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to the sufficiency of the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting about candidates for appointment to several Town boards.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that the Board deliberated about the candidates outside of a noticed meeting.
